entry.author: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise
entry.summary:
NZTE Beachhead advisor Hamish Ewart is a brand marketing specialist with 25+ years of experience in Australia and the USA. In this video, he explains how creating buyer personas can help you narrow your focus, target your business approach, and save yourself time and resources.

Download B2B and B2C buyer persona templates: https://my.nzte.govt.nz/article/how-to-create-buyer-personas-to-tailor-your-marketing
